pre_patch_lookup_behavior.reason: Generic registry fallback matched registry/governance/patches/*.json patterns without checking execution status vs lifecycle promotion.

execution_validation_lifecycle_separatio.status_field: status=EXECUTED maps process execution state only
execution_validation_lifecycle_separatio.validation_field: validation.result=pass maps script verification state only
execution_validation_lifecycle_separatio.authority_rule: Neither process execution nor verification state constitutes a lifecycle transition to live authority.

post_patch_lookup_behavior.reason: Executed or PASS proposal patch records are preserved and queryable but are not eligible for live authority lookup without an explicit governed lifecycle transition.

independent_surface_non_interference.rule: Affected implementation surfaces (e.g. scripts/global_validate.py, registry/formal_object_registry.json) retain their independent role assignments and resolve under existing role-aware query machinery.

global_accounting_preservation.rule: Patch 091 implements a reusable boundary only. All 23 target ambiguities remain individually blocking pending post-boundary item re-audit.
